From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, Feb 24, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Rollout plan review: Console onboarding checklist (feature flag, cohorts, go/no-go)
Attachments: Console_Onboarding_Checklist_Rollout_Plan_v3.pdf; GoNoGo_Criteria_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.xlsx

Team — sharing the updated rollout plan for the Console onboarding checklist MVP for review + sign-off.

Primary questions for this group:
1) Cohorts: who sees it first (dogfood vs limited external), and who’s explicitly excluded in the first 2 weeks?
2) Feature flag gating: are we aligned on exposure rules + kill switch behavior?
3) Go/no-go: are the criteria right (and measurable), and do we have clear owners for each?

Proposed sequence (high level):
- Phase 1 (internal dogfood): 1–2 weeks
  - Redwood employees only (feature flag + allowlist)
  - Goal: shake out event ordering, deep links, copy clarity, and step state correctness
- Phase 2 (external cohort): 2–3 weeks
  - New Hosted API signups only
  - 10% exposure for week 1; 25% week 2; 50% week 3 (subject to go/no-go gates)
  - Exclude: enterprise tenants, Dedicated, Private, and any accounts with SSO enforced (to avoid confounding auth setup flows)

Feature flag proposal:
- Flag name: console.onboarding_checklist.enabled
- Gating inputs: tenant_id hash (stable), created_at window, plan_type/self-serve, region
- Kill switch: ability to force OFF globally within 5 minutes; should also disable event-driven UI refresh to reduce load if we hit a telemetry ingestion incident

Go/no-go (draft):
- Data quality: <1% event ingestion failures for checklist events; <0.5% step state regressions (out-of-order) in dogfood
- Support readiness: macros and triage flow approved; Support has admin override tools available (ENG-5852)
- Reliability: dashboard freshness check in place; alerting configured (ENG-5815)
- UX: no P0 bugs from dogfood, no step blocking issues without workaround

Asks:
- Connor: confirm release mechanics for the cohort ramp + comms timeline
- Ben: confirm cohort definition aligns with lifecycle messaging and doesn’t conflict with other PLG experiments
- Dev/Priya: confirm Support requirements and minimum viable admin tools
- Sean/Logan: confirm kill switch + alert thresholds are realistic

If no major objections, I’d like to lock the plan by EOD Wed so we can align with the Phase 2 start window.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director of Product, Console
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 24, 2025 at 10:01 AM PST
Subject: Re: Rollout plan review: Console onboarding checklist (feature flag, cohorts, go/no-go)

+1 on excluding enterprise tenants initially.

Support asks (minimum for external cohort):
- Admin override MUST be available for Support on day 1 of external exposure:
  - mark step complete
  - reset step
  - view audit trail (who/when/why)
- A short internal “how to interpret checklist state” page (we can base on the playbook draft)
- Macros for the big three onboarding issues:
  - 401/403 invalid key / wrong env var
  - 429 surprises
  - streaming disconnects / reconnect guidance

If ENG-5852 is at risk, we should gate external rollout on it. Otherwise we’ll spend a lot of time explaining “it’s a known UI state issue” which is bad.

Dev
Dev Patel
Support Enablement

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 24, 2025 at 10:37 AM PST
Subject: Re: Rollout plan review: Console onboarding checklist (feature flag, cohorts, go/no-go)

On the kill switch behavior:
- I’m aligned with “off within 5 minutes,” but we should define what “off” means operationally.
  - Console UI hidden (good)
  - BUT event emission continues server-side (gateway) unless explicitly disabled; otherwise we’ll create holes in telemetry and make debugging the funnel harder.

Recommendation:
- Two toggles:
  1) UI exposure flag (Console)
  2) Event emission flag (gateway/control plane)

Default: UI can be turned off without touching event emission. Only turn off emission if we’re seeing a measurable perf/queue impact.

Alerts/go-no-go:
- Add a go/no-go gate on data freshness: onboarding KPI datasets < 30 min behind in steady state (or at minimum, visible in the dashboard). If users are checking usage/checklist and it’s stale, Support will get hammered.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, SRE

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 24, 2025 at 11:15 AM PST
Subject: Re: Rollout plan review: Console onboarding checklist (feature flag, cohorts, go/no-go)

Agree on splitting UI exposure vs event emission. We already have a path to do this cleanly:
- console.onboarding_checklist.enabled -> Console only
- onboarding_events.enabled -> gateway/control plane

On go/no-go thresholds:
- Ingestion failure <1% is fine, but we should also explicitly validate:
  - cardinality constraints (tenant_id/user_id fields) aren’t exploding
  - schema version is pinned (v1) and no optional fields are becoming “effectively required”

Data freshness:
- We can set an alert if the onboarding funnel dataset is >45 min behind, plus a “no events in last 15 min” anomaly check for new signups (to catch pipeline breaks quickly).

One more thing: during dogfood, please have someone sanity-check “step regressions” after the ENG-5866 fix lands. We saw out-of-order events from retries in the gateway in the previous build.

Logan
Logan Wright
Telemetry Platform Lead

Date: Mon, Feb 24, 2025 at 1:02 PM PST
Subject: Re: Rollout plan review: Console onboarding checklist (feature flag, cohorts, go/no-go)

Cohorts look reasonable. Two requests from PLG side:
1) Please exclude any cohort currently in the “new Console nav” experiment (we’re testing a left-nav restructure). If both land, attribution will be messy.
2) For the 10% external cohort, can we constrain further to “new accounts created after rollout date” (sounds like you already intend this) AND “no invited teammates yet” (single-user accounts) for week 1? That reduces permutations while we validate.

Also suggest we define the cohort ramp as time-based but with a manual gate at each step (10 -> 25 -> 50). Connor probably already has this in the release runbook.

Ben
Ben Carter
PLG Rollout & Lifecycle Messaging

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 24, 2025 at 2:26 PM PST
Subject: Re: Rollout plan review: Console onboarding checklist (feature flag, cohorts, go/no-go)

Approved directionally.

I want two explicit go/no-go checks before any external exposure:
- Support tooling ready (admin override + macros + playbook published). If we can’t resolve user confusion quickly, we lose the benefit of the checklist.
- “No silent failures” in the funnel: if events are dropping or the dashboard is stale, we should not ship the UI. We can’t introduce a progress UI that users can’t trust.

Marissa/Connor: please add a single-page runbook section: how to roll back (UI off, cohort off), and who is the DRI on the decision during business hours + after hours.

Alex
Alex Martinez
VP, Developer Experience

Date: Mon, Feb 24, 2025 at 4:41 PM PST
Subject: Re: Rollout plan review: Console onboarding checklist (feature flag, cohorts, go/no-go)

Thanks all — summarizing decisions + updates I’ll incorporate into v4.

Decisions / updates:
1) Two toggles (per Sean/Logan):
   - console.onboarding_checklist.enabled (UI exposure)
   - onboarding_events.enabled (event emission)
   Default rollback: UI off first; keep event emission on unless there’s a platform incident.

2) Cohort constraints (per Ben):
   - External cohort = new Hosted API accounts created after rollout start
   - Week 1: additionally constrain to single-user accounts (no invited teammates)
   - Exclude tenants in “new Console nav” experiment
   - Still excluding enterprise/Dedicated/Private/SSO-enforced for MVP

3) Go/no-go gates (per Alex + Support):
   - Support readiness is a hard gate for external exposure:
     - ENG-5852 admin override shipped and permissions validated for Support
     - Macros ready for 401/403, 429, streaming disconnect
     - Playbook page published + linked in Support channel
   - Telemetry trustworthiness is a hard gate:
     - Onboarding dataset freshness within 45 min; alert configured
     - “No events in last 15 min for new signups” anomaly alert configured
     - Step regression rate in dogfood below threshold post ENG-5866

4) Manual gates for ramp (Connor):
   - 10% -> 25% -> 50% is not automatic; requires explicit go/no-go at each stage

Owners / next steps:
- Connor: add rollback/runbook section with DRI coverage (biz hours + after hours)
- Dev/Priya: confirm Support macros + playbook content by Fri; we’ll link from the Console “Need help?” section
- Dylan/Chloe: confirm ENG-5852 timeline; if it slips, external cohort slips
- Logan: confirm alert configuration and dashboards are visible to Support/SRE (read-only)

I’ll send v4 tomorrow morning with these changes and ask for final approval by Wed EOD.

Marissa
